name: AutoLeaderboard
description: Automatically update the level leaderboards so that you don't have to do it yourself

issues.info: Having a problem with the mod? Report the issue on GitHub

update-trigger.name: Update Trigger
update-trigger.description:
When the leaderboard is updated:
- level-page: On level page (current behaviour, may cause rate limiting if opening many levels quickly)
- on-exit: On level exit (BetterInfo-style behaviour)
